description: Recurrent herpes simplex infection of the lips or nearby skin, commonly known as cold sores.
causes: Herpes simplex virus, most commonly HSV-1
risk_factors: Sun exposure, illness, stress, or other triggers may precipitate recurrence

appearance.general: Clusters of small vesicles on an erythematous base near the lip that later crust and heal.

warning_signs: Eye pain or eye redness with nearby herpes lesions requires urgent assessment.
prevention: Avoid kissing or direct contact with lesions while active.
Avoid sharing lip products or utensils during outbreaks.
